goal: Find a path to 10x or greater speedup of simulate!() while preserving mathematical correctness, physical fidelity, and API flexibility. All GPU code MUST use AcceleratedKernels.jl. ALL speedup claims MUST be backed by Metal GPU benchmarks.
v1_lesson: v1 spent 5 iterations on static analysis and CPU benchmarks. The resulting optimizations produced ZERO speedup on Metal GPU. v2 requires GPU benchmarks for every claim.

context.scope: simulate!() ONLY — forward projection + detector physics pipeline. Reconstruction (reconstruct!) is OUT OF SCOPE.
context.architecture: AcceleratedKernels.jl (AK.jl) for GPU-agnostic execution (Metal/CUDA/ROCm/CPU). Zero-allocation workspace pattern. Polychromatic via sequential energy bin loop.
context.hard_constraint: AcceleratedKernels.jl is NON-NEGOTIABLE. All GPU compute must go through AK.jl. No backend-specific kernels.
context.math_constraint: Same mathematical results (within floating-point tolerance). Same API. Same physics fidelity.
context.gpu_constraint: ALL performance measurements on Metal GPU with Metal.@sync + @elapsed. CPU-only benchmarks are NOT acceptable evidence.

gpu_baseline.fused_vs_unfused: Fused is 3.65x SLOWER on Metal GPU (register spill at 234 bins)

topics.title: GPU Profiling Baseline — Metal @elapsed on every component of simulate!()
topics.notes: Baseline established. Fused kernel 3.65x SLOWER on GPU. Forward proj 88.7% of time. 234 energy bins (not 30). Signal chain 8.2%. Physics pipeline 0.4%.

topics.title: Tiled Energy Fusion — K=16 bins per DDA pass, 3.79× GPU-validated
topics.notes: GPU VALIDATED: K=16 → 97.45ms/tile × 15 tiles = 1462ms (3.79× vs unfused 5546ms). Per-bin marginal cost = 6ms (constant). Theoretical minimum 1404ms. K=16 is 96% of optimum. Build story SPEED-BUILD-V2-002 created. Benchmark: ralph_loops/bench_speed_001.jl

topics.title: Ray Tracing Algorithm — GPU-validated alternatives to Siddon
topics.notes: Current Siddon: 22.85ms per call for 2.95M rays through 128^3 volume. Tiled per-bin cost is 6ms (the new bottleneck). Could a different projector (distance-driven, Joseph's) reduce this? Key: must work through AK.jl.

topics.title: GPU Kernel Optimization — reduce per-bin 6ms floor cost
topics.notes: Tiled fusion revealed 6ms per-bin marginal cost as the new bottleneck. Can we reduce this via: (a) better μ_table layout, (b) reduced-precision accumulation, (c) empty-space skipping, (d) fewer exp() calls? Must measure on Metal.

topics.title: Signal Chain Fusion — fuse 5-6 elementwise kernels into 1-2
topics.notes: Signal chain is 487ms (8.2%) — five AK.foreachindex kernels each ~120ms. Fusing exp→heel→air→cal→log→BHC into 1-2 kernels could save ~287ms. Not enough for 10× alone but contributes.

topics.title: SYNTHESIS: GPU-validated 10x speedup roadmap with build stories
topics.notes: Current best projection: tiled fusion (3.79× on fwd proj) + signal chain fusion (~1.5× on chain) → ~3.4× total. 10× requires ~3× more from SPEED-002/003. Need to evaluate whether 10× is achievable or if SPEED_BLOCKED is the right call.
